verdict.rationale: Unleash documents 15 official client and server SDKs (over 30 including community ones) and a quickstart that connects an application by integrating an SDK, with code examples and CodeSandbox demos. A community report independently confirms official clients for Java, Node.js, Go, Ruby and Python. missing for 10: evidence on per-SDK API reference depth and feature parity across the official SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: It supports 15 official client and server SDKs and over 15 community SDKs.
